name: Auto-fixes
author: Brett
description: Every call that failed and is being fixed automatically on the server (retry-ladder@1): what failed, which fix on the ladder it is trying now ("store locked: clearing stale lock, step 2 of 3"), attempts so far, live; and the ones that gave up after the whole ladder, with what is missing. Shows as its own banner across the top or as a banner widget with a count (Settings → Plugins → Auto-fixes, or REST / MCP / CLI / voice). Each job is logged in the AmberX list "Automatic fixes"; a job that gives up sends Brett one AmberX FYI.
